# Trump poll finds most states disapprove of his job performance

Portrait of Natassia Paloma

Most states disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance, including Texas.

According to an approval tracker from The Economist and YouGov, Trump’s net job approval rating in Texas is -22, meaning his disapproval rating is 22 percentage points higher than his approval rating.

Texas is far from alone. [...] The tracker shows 47 of the 50 states with negative net approval ratings for Trump. Only three states have positive net approval ratings for the president: Wyoming at +14, Idaho at +9 and West Virginia at +6. All three went for Trump in the 2016, 2020, and 2020 presidential elections,

The survey, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump’s performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has seen in YouGov tracking since he returned to office in 2025. [...] The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted Aug. 7-10 among 1,589 U.S. adults. The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3.2 percentage points.
